entries.title: gm/ID Explorer - Open PDK Hub
entries.desc: Unified gm/ID explorer for three open-source PDKs: interactive MOSFET characterisation curves (gm/ID, fT, gm/gds and more versus V<sub>GS</sub>, V<sub>ov</sub> and channel length) for gm/ID-based analog design.

entries.title: Career Semi-Quant Terminal
entries.desc: Quantitative stock analytics for semiconductor professionals evaluating equity offers. Runs entirely in the browser.

entries.title: FX Quant Terminal
entries.desc: Zero-server quantitative FX analysis for seven INR currency pairs (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, CNY, SGD, HKD): ensemble forecasting, technical indicators, risk analytics and seasonality.

entries.title: Research Radar
entries.desc: Aggregates papers, preprints and blog posts on AI, finance and chip design from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, CrossRef and research blogs into one live feed, with an optional Claude-powered paper explainer and Google Scholar author feeds via SerpApi.

entries.title: Conference Deadline Tracker
entries.desc: Tracks conference information such as submission deadlines, with a calendar feed and change log.
